听了王野这话王野村长立刻来了兴趣，拍着胸脯保证道：“小王同志放心，我爹原来是十里八村有名的参把头，我年轻那会儿一直跟着他跑山，周围这几个村里的参把头我都认识，我这就带着你去找他们。”

说完就把他媳妇叫进来，把王野刚给的钱交给媳妇。还嘱咐了两句就领着王野出门了。这村长还是有点小计较的，先从自己村子开始，王野听着他们的对话还能分出关系的亲疏远近。先去的都是关系好的，王野猜想他应该是怕自己身上的钱不多。

一下午村长才带着王野转完了整个村子，边买边打听，王野觉得这个村子能买到的人参都让他扫荡完了。几乎三分之一的人家都有，虽然大部分都是十年以下的，但是也收到了一些高年份的。

这些人参什么包装都有，有用红布包着的，有用红纸的，好的就像村长家那种用木盒的，王野数了一下：三十年的收了5支，二十年的收了14支，十年和十年以下的收了20多支。一共花了六百多块，一些年份特别少的王野给的也不多。

在村长家拿了背篓，所有的人参都放在里面。到了快天黑时，村长犹豫了半天对王野说道：“小王同志，我们村其实还有一家，应该也有棒槌。”

王野一看他这个样子就问道：“怎么，这家跟你关系不好？”

村长叹了口气说道：“不是跟我关系不好，是跟整个村子的关系都不好，我说的这家姓翟，这老头是现在村里唯一猎人。”

王野一听是猎人，顿时来了兴趣好奇的问道：“怎么回事呀？”

村长叹了口气：“还不是公社闹得，那帮犊子隔三差五的就来一趟，来了就要吃要喝的，就咱这小屯子那禁得起这么造呀，村里人就想着让老翟头提供些野味儿，村里给他算公分，可这老头油盐不进就是不干。”

王野心想：“别说这老头不干，就是他也不干呀。打到猎物就算喂狗都比给那帮人有用。”

可是王野并没有发表意见，王野说：“大爷，既然你不方便那我就自己去。”

王野走进院子喊了一声：“有人吗？”

接着从屋里出来一个小老头，个子不高，样貌也不出众，唯独那双眼睛特别犀利。在看到王野后面无表情的问：“你谁呀？找谁呀？”

王野上前两步回道：“翟大爷，我是四九城来的，来咱们村子收点人参什么的，我听村民说您这儿有，这不就来问问。”

翟老头没好气的说：“他们家家都有，你找我干啥？”

王野也不隐瞒，把后面的背篓放到前面：“大爷，我在村里都收了，就差您家了。”

翟老头上前看了看疑惑的问王野：“小伙儿，你这是给了他们多少钱呀，他们一个个肯把这些卖给你，平时这玩意儿好像镶在他们肋条上似的。”

王野微微一笑：“大爷我给他们的价格是收购点儿的十倍。”

翟老头像看傻子一样看着王野：“小子，我的也按这个价儿？”

王野被他看得有点儿不高兴：“大爷，你要是在用这种眼神看我，我最高给你两倍。”

翟老头赶紧收回自己的目光，尴尬的说道：“不看不看了，走走，进屋。”

进了屋翟老头让王野在堂屋等儿，他自己去了最里面的一个小屋，没一会儿就抱着一摞木盒子。王野一下子就被惊住了，这老头存货不少呀。

翟老头把盒子放在桌子上，对王野说：“看看我的这些吧。”

After hearing Wang Ye's words, Village Chief Wang Ye immediately became interested. He patted his chest and promised: "Comrade Xiao Wang, don't worry, my father turned out to be a famous ginseng leader in Shiliba Village. When I was young, I followed him in the mountains. I know all the ginseng leaders in the surrounding villages. I will take you to find them."

After saying that, he called his wife in and handed her the money Wang Ye had just given.After giving a few instructions, he led Wang Ye out.The village chief was still a bit fussy, starting with his own village. Wang Ye could tell the closeness of their relationship while listening to their conversation.Those who went first were those with good connections. Wang Ye guessed that he was afraid that he didn't have much money.

The village chief took Wang Ye around the entire village in one afternoon, asking around while buying. Wang Ye felt that he had wiped out all the ginseng available in the village.Almost one-third of the households have one, and although most are under ten years old, some older vintages have also been received.

These ginseng are available in all kinds of packaging, some are wrapped in red cloth, some are in red paper, and the good ones are like the ones in the village chief's house with wooden boxes. Wang Ye counted: 5 ginseng from thirty years old, 14 ginseng from 20 years old, and more than 20 ginseng from ten years or younger.It cost more than 600 yuan in total, and Wang Ye, who was of particularly low vintage, didn't give much.

I got a backpack from the village chief's house and put all the ginseng in it.When it was almost dark, the village chief hesitated for a long time and said to Wang Ye: "Comrade Xiao Wang, there is actually another family in our village, and they should also have Bangchui."

When Wang Ye saw him like this, he asked, "Why, this family doesn't have a good relationship with you?"

The village chief sighed and said, "It's not that we don't have a good relationship with me, but that we don't have a good relationship with the entire village. The family I'm talking about is named Zhai, and this old man is the only hunter in the village now."

When Wang Ye heard that he was a hunter, he immediately became interested and asked curiously: "What's going on?"

The village chief sighed: "It's not the commune that's causing the trouble. Those brats come here every now and then, and they need food and drink when they come. Our small village can't afford to do this. The villagers want to ask Old Zhaitou to provide some game. The village will give him centimeters, but this old man won't do it if he doesn't get enough food and salt."

Wang Ye thought: "Don't say this old man doesn't do it, even he doesn't do it. If you catch prey, even feeding it to the dogs will be more useful than feeding it to those people."

But Wang Ye did not express his opinion. Wang Ye said: "Uncle, since it is inconvenient for you, I will go by myself."

Wang Ye walked into the yard and shouted: "Is there anyone there?"

Then a little old man came out of the house. He was not tall and his appearance was not outstanding, but his eyes were particularly sharp.After seeing Wang Ye, he asked expressionlessly: "Who are you? Who are you looking for?"

Wang Ye took two steps forward and replied: "Uncle Zhai, I'm from Sijiu City. I came to our village to collect some ginseng or something. I heard from the villagers that you have it here, so I came to ask."

Old Man Zhai said angrily: "Everyone of them has it, what do you want from me?"

Wang Ye didn't hide anything, and put the backpack on the back in front: "Uncle, I collected everything in the village, and I just need to send it to your family."

Old Man Zhai looked forward and asked Wang Ye in confusion: "Young man, how much did you pay them? They are willing to sell these to you one by one. Usually, this thing seems to be embedded in their ribs."

Wang Ye smiled slightly: "Sir, the price I gave them was ten times the price I paid for them."

Old Man Zhai looked at Wang Ye as if he were a fool: "Boy, is mine also priced at this price?"

Wang Ye was a little unhappy when he saw him: "Uncle, if you look at me like this, I will give you twice as much at most."

Old Man Zhai quickly retracted his gaze and said awkwardly: "I don't want to look at it anymore. Let's take a walk and go into the house."

After entering the house, Old Man Zhai asked Wang Ye to wait in the main room. He went to the innermost hut, and soon he was holding a stack of wooden boxes.Wang Ye was shocked at once. This old man had a lot of stock.

Old Man Zhai put the box on the table and said to Wang Ye, "Take a look at these."
